summary: CERN's Doctoral Student Programme 2027-1 offers doctoral students a contract of 12 to 36 months, onsite in Geneva, Switzerland, ideally starting on 1 April 2027. It suits PhD students in physics, engineering and computing who want to carry out thesis research at CERN, provided their university agrees that this research contributes to the PhD thesis.
highlights: For doctoral students in physics, engineering and computing.
Contract of 12 to 36 months, onsite in Geneva, with an ideal start on 1 April 2027.
Your university must agree that research at CERN contributes to your PhD thesis.
